name: Australian Capital Territory law: the Acts in force, republication by republication
label: Australian Capital Territory
acts: Tobacco and Other Smoking Products Act 1927 (A1927-14)
Anglican Church of Australia Trust Property Act 1928 (A1928-19)
Roman Catholic Church Property Trust Act 1937 (A1937-2)
Presbyterian Church (Proposals for Union with other Churches) Act 1972 (A1972-17)
Standard Time and Summer Time Act 1972 (A1972-34)
Sexuality and Gender Identity Conversion Practices Act 2020 (A2020-49)
Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Children and Young People Commissioner Act 2022 (A2022-25)
record_note: Every Act in force on the ACT Legislation Register whose republications are held in Word form, from its first such republication to the last one in force on or before 2026-10-29; data retrieved up to 2026-10-29. Each republication is a checked snapshot; changes between two republications are credited by the later one's endnote amendment history.

dates.time: 12:00 Canberra (AEST, UTC+10; AEDT, UTC+11, in daylight saving time)

scope.when_absent: this corpus records no scope notes (no commit carries Applies:); the absence is not a statement that the change reaches every case

default_reach.rule: presumption against retrospective operation; repeal or amendment does not disturb what was done or accrued before
default_reach.meaning: an ACT law is presumed not to operate retrospectively on substantive rights unless it says so; the repeal or amendment of a law does not affect its previous operation or rights and liabilities acquired or incurred under it
default_reach.authority: Legislation Act 2001 (ACT) s 84 (Saving of operation of repealed and amended laws); Maxwell v Murphy (1957) 96 CLR 261 (common-law presumption); not checked in this corpus

verification: Every republication used is checked against its own Word file on its effective day (tools/build/check_repo.py).
